source_verification.method: Compared complete whitespace-normalized applicable PDF page extraction with the supplied extracted text; inspected page images for item icons/setup and ruin-stack procedure. Excluded chapters on the shared appendix pages were not treated as in-scope rules.

findings.finding: The broad request to explain Decree resolution is not completely keyed for the ordinary Recruit action. The key says only Recruit at matching roost, without requiring placement of exactly one warrior per Recruit action/card.
findings.source_text: Recruit. Place a warrior in any clearing with a roost whose suit matches the card suit.
findings.why_material: Eyrie has its own Recruit procedure, separate from Marquise Recruit and Alliance Recruit. Q40 states Charismatic recruits two but its key does not say instead of the normal one. A purported ordinary Recruit of multiple warriors is not explicitly excluded by the current Q12 target.
findings.proposed_answer_edit: Replace Recruit at matching roost with Recruit places one warrior in a clearing with a roost whose suit matches the card; Charismatic instead must place two. Retain the existing Move/Battle/Build/order/turmoil clauses.
findings.novelty: Existing Q12 broad request already owns this procedure. This is correction of a missing required effect/quantity, not a new numeric scenario or an additional question.

findings.finding: The item/ruin setup target includes only a shorthand that Vagabond hides four R items, one each. It omits the source shuffle/return procedure for the hidden ruin stacks; Q35 explicitly excludes hidden ruin items.
findings.source_text: Place one beneath each ruin and then shuffle each ruin stack. Then, return each stack to an empty ruin slot on the map.
findings.why_material: The assigned source gives a procedure for setting the hidden Explore rewards. This is different from merely putting four ruins on R slots or placing the common craftable-item supply. A hand-chosen known ruin arrangement is not the complete stated setup procedure.
findings.proposed_answer_edit: After ordinary map supply/ruins, require: if Vagabond is present, take the four R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword, place one beneath each ruin, shuffle the ruin stacks as instructed, then return the stacks to empty R ruin slots. Do not apply the two-Vagabond rule.
findings.novelty: Interpret the existing broad Q07 ruins/item setup request as owning this procedure, so correct its target rather than append a second setup question. If Q07 is intended to cover only 5.1, then this must instead become one explicitly scoped Vagabond ruin-setup question; Q35 cannot cover it by wording.
